[[File:Show_Girls.jpg|thumb|right|220px|A advertisement for Show Girls]]
'''Show Girls''' was a stage entertainment show, active on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It featured scantily clad [[Gender/Legends|female]] performers. The show was promoted via [[Show Girls (advertisement)/Legends|posters]], and screen advertisements on [[Hover taxi/Legends|hover taxis]], which stated the name of the show in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] letters.<ref name="Lethal">{{TCW|Lethal Trackdown}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The female [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] used to advertise the show is wearing an outfit similar to [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia's]] [[Huttese slave-girl costume]] in [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']].<ref name="Lethal" />
